text:
Under UCC 2-207, Costco's order confirmation operated as an acceptance even though it added the loading charge, and between merchants the added term is treated as a proposal that becomes part of the contract unless it materially alters the deal. A loading charge of $50 per thousand envelopes likely materially alters the contract, so it would be excluded and the contract would be enforced at $1,000 CIF. Therefore the court would likely rule A.

CONFIDENCE: 75
